shortDescription: Manage NAS servers on Unity storage system

options.name: allow_unmapped_user
options.description: This flag is used to mandatorily disable access in case of any user mapping failure. If C(true), then enable access in case of any user mapping failure. If C(false), then disable access in case of any user mapping failure. It can be mentioned during modification of the NAS server.

options.name: current_unix_directory_service
options.description: This is the directory service used for querying identity information for UNIX (such as UIDs, GIDs, net groups). It can be mentioned during modification of the NAS server.

options.name: default_unix_user
options.description: Default Unix user name used for granting access in the case of Windows to Unix user mapping failure. It can be mentioned during modification of the NAS server.

options.name: default_windows_user
options.description: Default windows user name used for granting access in the case of Unix to Windows user mapping failure. It can be mentioned during modification of the NAS server.

options.name: enable_windows_to_unix_username_mapping
options.displayName: Enable Windows To Unix Username Mapping
options.description: This parameter indicates whether a Unix to/from Windows user name mapping is enabled. It can be mentioned during modification of the NAS server.

options.name: is_backup_only
options.description: It specifies whether the NAS server is used as backup only. It can be mentioned during modification of the NAS server.

options.name: is_multiprotocol_enabled
options.description: This parameter indicates whether multiprotocol sharing mode is enabled. It can be mentioned during modification of the NAS server.

options.name: is_packet_reflect_enabled
options.description: If the packet has to be reflected, then this parameter has to be set to C(true). It can be mentioned during modification of the NAS server.

options.name: is_replication_destination
options.description: It specifies whether the NAS server is a replication destination. It can be mentioned during modification of the NAS server.

options.name: nas_server_id
options.description: The ID of the NAS server. Either I(nas_server_name) or I(nas_server_id) is required to perform the task. The parameters I(nas_server_name) and I(nas_server_id) are mutually exclusive.

options.name: nas_server_name
options.description: The Name of the NAS server. Either I(nas_server_name) or I(nas_server_id)  is required to perform the task. The parameters I(nas_server_name) and I(nas_server_id) are mutually exclusive.

options.name: nas_server_new_name
options.description: The new name of the NAS server. It can be mentioned during modification of the NAS server.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the Unity management server.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number through which communication happens with Unity management server.

options.name: replication_params
options.description: Settings required for enabling replication.

options.name: replication_reuse_resource
options.description: This parameter indicates if existing NAS Server is to be used for replication.

options.name: replication_state
options.description: State of the replication.

options.name: state
options.description: Define the state of NAS server on the array. The value present indicates that NAS server should exist on the system after the task is executed. In this release deletion of NAS server is not supported. Hence, if state is set to C(absent) for any existing NAS server then error will be thrown. For any non-existing NAS server, if state is set to C(absent) then it will return None.

options.name: unispherehost
options.description: IP or FQDN of the Unity management server.

options.name: username
options.description: The username of the Unity management server.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether or not to validate SSL certificate. C(true) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. C(false) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
